title: Hybrid Codebase Context Compressor — Model2Vec + sqlite-vec (98% token reduction)
description: MCP server that compresses large codebase context for Claude Code by combining Model2Vec sentence embeddings with sqlite-vec vector search. Claims 98% token reduction on large codebases. Unlike code-review-graph (knowledge graph approach, NEEDS_RESEARCH in pipeline), this uses dense vector embeddings to rank files by semantic relevance to the current query, then serves only the top-k most relevant files. Zero external API dependency — Model2Vec runs locally, sqlite-vec is a SQLite extension.
notes: Comparison required with code-review-graph (49x token reduction, NEEDS_RESEARCH from 2026-03-19) before full evaluation. Both target the same problem (large codebase context overflow) but via different mechanisms: knowledge graph vs vector embeddings. Key questions: (1) GitHub repo URL and star count, (2) overlap with code-review-graph — evaluate together or separately, (3) local-only is a strong advantage vs cloud-dependent alternatives. If verified, likely scores 65-75 depending on community validation.
